articles.title: Tata Sons listing row: Vijay Singh seeks urgent probe into Dorabji Tata Trust's proposed legal action

articles.title: What is EPFO Amnesty Scheme 2026? Importance of one-time window to regularise legacy PF trusts
articles.summary: Over the years, several establishments formed independent PF trust to administer benefits for their employees. In many instances, these trusts obtained recognition under the Income-tax Act, 1961 and operated as employer-managed.

articles.title: Why does India face one of the highest US tariffs without a trade deal?
articles.summary: The US has proposed a tax of up to 25 per cent on Indian goods. It could fall to 17 per cent if India signs a deal the US accepts.

articles.title: Noel Tata-led welfare trust gets nod to invest Rs 150 crore in equities amid Tata boardroom dispute
articles.summary: In an order dated November 6, Maharashtra Charity Commissioner Amogh Kaloti permitted the trust to undertake investments in one or more tranches.

articles.title: Higher borrowing costs weigh on G4 economies, cloud 2027 rate hike outlook: Report
articles.summary: Global business activity is facing a slowdown, impacted by increased borrowing costs and prevailing economic uncertainty. Anticipated interest rate hikes from central banks in the US, UK, Japan, and the eurozone in December may set the tone for financial markets.

articles.title: Is Trump killing the China+1 strategy? Why global manufacturers may consider moving back to China
articles.summary: According to a report, the proposed tariffs could erode the competitive advantages enjoyed by alternative manufacturing destinations, particularly in Southeast Asia, forcing companies to reassess their investment and supply-chain strategies.

articles.title: Rs 86 lakh flat construction stalled; builder ordered to refund 9% interest, settle home loan
articles.summary: A homebuyer booked a 237-square-yard residential floor in a real estate project in Sonipat in February 2017. He paid Rs 14.76 lakh towards the property and also got a home loan. According to his complaint, the possession was promised by October 2019.

articles.summary: A Delhi study finds 87.5% of respondents feel unsafe walking to metro stations or bus stops, citing poor lighting, broken footpaths and harassment. Here's what the findings reveal.

articles.summary: Explore 5 CNG cars under ₹10 lakh offering claimed mileage of up to 34.43 km/kg. From Alto K10 to Swift and Hyundai Exter, check prices, features and fuel efficiency.

articles.summary: In October, India’s economy showcased impressive resilience, bolstered by heightened consumption and credit activities. However, retail inflation climbed to 6.1%, eclipsing the RBI's target as multiple sectors faced price hikes.

articles.title: 85-year-old wins case to evict son and daughter-in-law from Delhi home

articles.title: RBI moves 60 tonnes of gold to India in 6 months
articles.summary: Reserve Bank of India shifted 60.1 tonnes of gold to domestic storage, raising domestic holdings to 740.1 tonnes. This transfer reflects a growing preference for domestic gold custody among central banks. As of September 2026, total gold reserves remained at 880.5 tonnes.

articles.title: Tata trust can invest Rs 150 crore in shares

articles.summary: In a strong show of market resilience on Wednesday, Sensex and Nifty reached nine-month peaks, thanks to vigorous institutional buying. The Sensex alone soared past the 84,000 benchmark as foreign funds continued to pour in.
